name: Rye Foreshore Market
address: Rye Foreshore, Point Nepean Rd, Rye VIC 3941
signature: A first-Saturday market on Rye foreshore, listed by Mornington Peninsula Shire.
editorNote: Rye Foreshore Market is listed by Mornington Peninsula Shire for the first Saturday of each month, 8.30am–2pm, on the Rye foreshore opposite the Rye Hotel. Check the Shire event page before travelling for the current date and any changes.
